hypotheses.title: Parent-union recovery
hypotheses.mechanism: Select a diverse union of archived parents to recover complementary retrieval.
hypotheses.minimum_slice: Deterministic selector; at most seven parents; 63 candidates; target-free freeze.
hypotheses.metric: Real retrieval and exact tasks per verifier call
hypotheses.falsifier: V3 retrieval is not recovered and efficiency does not improve
hypotheses.promotion_gate: Non-inferior retrieval and at least two incremental real tasks

hypotheses.title: Operation-conditioned edits
hypotheses.mechanism: Allocate typed color and enum edits from parent AST and residual signatures.
hypotheses.minimum_slice: Typed edit policy with held-out scoring
hypotheses.promotion_gate: Two incremental real tasks without call inflation

hypotheses.title: Anti-unified parent schemas
hypotheses.mechanism: Anti-unify exact demonstration programs then instantiate supported fields.

hypotheses.title: Residual relational signatures

hypotheses.title: Counterexample-directed repair

hypotheses.minimum_slice: Repair loop capped at two edits
hypotheses.promotion_gate: 25 percent call reduction at matched yield

hypotheses.title: Lossless typed codec
